title: Why Pirates Almost Never Buried Treasure #Shorts
description:
Pirates almost never buried their treasure. Here's why. Pirates usually spent their loot fast, on food, drink and fun in port. Why hide it in the sand? There is one famous exception: Captain William Kidd.
